reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for configuring and injecting custom HTTP headers into model requests, with provider and model scoping plus a settings interface and provider synchronization.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可按全局、提供商和模型配置并注入自定义 HTTP 请求头的设置插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness settings plugin for configuring and injecting custom HTTP headers into model requests by global, provider, or model scope.

capabilities: Injects custom HTTP headers into configured large-model requests
Supports global, provider-specific, model-specific, and host-specific header rules
Synchronizes configured headers into provider request settings
Modifies local harness source files as part of required integration patches
